monthly_review.summary: This month shows a clear shift toward higher-intensity running (↑Z3/Z4 %, ↑avg HR, ↓avg pace) versus last month’s predominantly aerobic base work, with modest gains in efficiency but declining cadence consistency.
monthly_review.highlight: The largest shift is the 12-percentage-point drop in Z1 time (from 43% to 20%) and concurrent 12-point rise in Z3 time (26% → 32%), confirming a deliberate, sustained move into threshold work — consistent across July (29% Z3), August (26%), and now September (32%).

goal_tracker.message: You’ve already exceeded last month’s distance (66.0 vs 51.3 km) and sessions (13 vs 10); no further running is needed to match — and given missing recovery data, adding volume in the final 6 days is not advisable.

insights.title: Threshold dominance without Z5 support
insights.body: Z3 accounts for 32% of this month’s running — up from 26% last month and 29% in July — yet Z5 remains at just 1%, suggesting sustained sub-maximal efforts without neuromuscular or VO2max-specific stimulus; this may explain the rising aerobic TE (+0.3) and slight efficiency dip (+0.48 ml/kg/km).

insights.title: Cadence-efficiency misalignment
insights.body: Cadence dropped from 149 spm (Aug) to 145 spm (Sep) while efficiency worsened (14.12 → 14.6 ml/kg/km); notably, stride length also declined (July: 83.28 avg in recent runs, but July’s monthly avg cadence was only 118 spm — indicating inconsistent form), suggesting fatigue or pacing variability is disrupting economy.

insights.title: Pace-HR decoupling emerging
insights.body: Avg pace improved (-34 sec/km) while avg HR rose (+7 bpm) — a rare inverse relationship that, combined with rising aerobic TE (+0.3), signals reduced aerobic efficiency at given intensities; this mirrors the 0.18 ml/kg/km efficiency decline from June (13.46) to now (14.6).

recommendations.action: Run 4.5 km Zone 2 (HR ≤ 135 bpm) on Tuesday, focusing on cadence ≥150 spm and relaxed arm swing.
recommendations.reason: Restores aerobic rhythm without taxing recovery systems; counters recent cadence drop and rising aerobic TE.

recommendations.action: Complete 20 min barefoot or minimalist strides on grass: 6 × 20-sec light accelerations with full recovery, emphasizing quiet footstrike and minimal vertical oscillation (<8.0 cm).
recommendations.reason: Targets vertical oscillation (currently 8.1–8.6 cm in 6 of last 10 runs) and ground contact time (≥301 ms), both elevated vs ideal biomechanical efficiency.

recommendations.action: Skip all runs Thursday–Saturday; instead perform 30 min guided HRV breathing (5s in / 5s out) + 7h+ sleep tracking with no screen use 90 min before bed.
recommendations.reason: Compensates for missing HRV/sleep data by proactively supporting autonomic recovery — essential before reintroducing Z3 work.

risk_flags.evidence: Aerobic TE increased from 2.6 (Aug) to 2.9 (Sep); efficiency worsened from 14.12 to 14.6 ml/kg/km; avg HR rose +7 bpm despite faster pace
risk_flags.action: Pause Z3 accumulation for 1 week; retest aerobic TE on a standardized 6 km Z2 run (HR 128–135 bpm)
